name: hud_stack_rival_line_names_both_waves
description: In Tide Race each hollow stacks on its own clock, and the rival line names the waves on the rival's road (M8, design 2.7 and 5.7): racing the caretaker, whose Lamplighter calls wave 2 during wave 1 and wave 3 during wave 2 (its plan's stack list, so her first three waves walk together), the strip's second line reads 'Rival · Waves 1–2 · ...' with two on its road, 'Rival · Waves 1–3 · ...' with three, 'Rival · Waves 2–3 · ...' once wave 1 cleared there, and 'Rival · Wave 3 · ...' once wave 2 did (with seed 1 waves 2 and 3 clear on one tick there, into the window before wave 4).
